title: Technical SEO report
subtitle: Merchant demo / scan, fix, verify
scoreNote: Average across the 21 scanned targets. A technical-check score, not a measure of traffic, ranking or AI citations.
aiNote: A separate technical-check score for machine readability and access. It does not measure visibility or citations in AI answers.
comparisonNote: Both scans completed all 21 targets with no failures. The second scan verified the saved description; no new issues were recorded.
fixBody: A 142-character SEO description was saved for Post #5 in the free Filament editor. The next scan marked that exact issue as fixed. The other 19 findings remained open.
scope: Local demonstration with seeded content. Captured 9 September 2026; redesigned and translated September 2026. Search Console and AI-bot logging were disabled. No traffic, ranking or citation results are claimed.
inventoryNote: The 19 findings below are grouped by check. Counts describe issues, not unique affected pages. Record names and route paths identify the original demo targets.

actions.title: Fill the remaining gap
actions.body: Add a useful description to Product #5, then rescan to verify that the issue is resolved.

actions.title: Review long metadata
actions.body: Review the titles of Post #4, Product #1 and Page #4, plus Post #4's description. Keep the wording useful; length checks are editorial prompts, not ranking rules.

actions.title: Assess the notices in context
actions.body: Review the short titles, descriptions and page bodies for relevance and completeness. Avoid padding text just to pass a length check.

methodBody: This redesigned companion summarizes the recorded scan and report evidence. It is not the default Pro PDF layout. The original local demo used Laravel 12 and Filament 4 with Rankbeam Core, the free editor and Pro. Only the two captured scans are compared; no earlier history was filled in.
